preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000.
String s must consist of lowercase Latin letters.
String t must consist of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of ways to extract k non-overlapping substrings containing t, modulo 10^9 + 7.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= len(s) <= 10**5","description":"The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= len(t) <= 10**5","description":"The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(c.islower() for c in s)","description":"String s must consist of lowercase Latin letters."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(c.islower() for c in t)","description":"String t must consist of lowercase Latin letters."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(result % (10**9 + 7))","description":"The output must be the number of ways to extract k non-overlapping substrings containing t, modulo 10^9 + 7."}],"invariants":[]}
